name: Cocke County, TN
findings: Cocke County has 57 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Cocke County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Cocke County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Cocke County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
